claim: DON retains records for specific periods and disposes per approved schedules (44 USC Ch 33 and M-5210.1).
quote: To ensure that all records are programmed for retention or periodic destruction and that every activity and office properly applies the retention standards

claim: Every record reaches one of three end states: permanent, long-term then disposed, short-term.
paragraph: Ch 1 para 4c Destruction of Temporary Records or Legal Transfer of Permanent Records
quote: the end result for every Marine Corps record is either destruction according to a NARA-approved disposition, or permanent archive at NARA
fix: State two end states, temporary (destroy on the NARA-approved date) or permanent (transfer to NARA). Present long and short retention as temporary schedules.

claim: DD-214, personal awards, Officer Qualification Records and significant disciplinary records are permanent.
quote: DRMD will maintain all of the DON retention schedules on the website list in paragraph 2b below.
fix: Part III of the cached manual holds no schedule table. Pull each SSIC schedule from the DRMD approved-schedules site and cite the schedule number.

claim: OMPF documents are retained 75 years after separation.
quote: DRMD will maintain all of the DON retention schedules on the website list in paragraph 2b below.
fix: No archived paragraph sets a 75-year OMPF period. The only 75-year hit is a radiation-exposure record in Part V. Verify against the SSIC 1070 schedule on the DRMD site or drop the number. Page also lists awards as permanent at line 55 and 75 years at line 91.

claim: Pay records are retained per DOD FMR Volume 7A schedules.
quote: No retention or disposition paragraph found in the chapter.
fix: Vol 7A Ch 1 covers basic pay entitlement, not record retention. Cite the DON schedule for pay records or the DoD FMR volume that carries the retention table.

claim: Routine personnel actions are retained per IRAM schedules.
quote: File not in archive text cache.
fix: Obtain MCO P1070.12K and cite the IRAM paragraph. Note PAA 05-23 and older MARADMINs also touch this order.

claim: Working papers 1 year, routine correspondence 2 years, drafts 1 year, convenience copies until no longer needed.
quote: DRMD will maintain all of the DON retention schedules on the website list in paragraph 2b below.
fix: Cite the SSIC schedule that sets each period or mark them as local guidance. Tables at lines 111-114 repeat the numbers and add tracking logs at 3 years.

claim: NARA approves federal retention schedules and M-5210.1 implements them for DON records.
quote: All NARA records disposition policies and guidelines have been approved by the Archivist of the United States

claim: PAC cannot deviate from NARA-approved schedules and local policy supplements but does not override.
quote: It is unlawful to dispose of records before expiration of the retention period.
fix: Add that an extension request goes to HQMC ARDB via the chain of command.

claim: Fitness reports, Page 11 entries, NJP records, promotion warrants, school certificates and enlistment contracts are retained 75 years post-separation.
quote: DRMD will maintain all of the DON retention schedules on the website list in paragraph 2b below.
fix: Table gives a 75-year period per document type with no archived schedule behind it. Verify each row or cite the schedule number.

claim: Pay records and personnel transactions in MCTFS are retained 75 years post-separation.
quote: DRMD will maintain all of the DON retention schedules on the website list in paragraph 2b below.
fix: Cite the schedule or remove the period.

claim: MCTFS audit trails retained 7 years minimum.
quote: DRMD will maintain all of the DON retention schedules on the website list in paragraph 2b below.
fix: Cite the schedule or remove the period.

claim: Tracking logs are kept 3 years then destroyed.
quote: DRMD will maintain all of the DON retention schedules on the website list in paragraph 2b below.
fix: Cite the schedule or remove the period.

claim: Track records due in 90 days and 30 days and review the list monthly.
quote: An annual inspection and review of local disposal procedures and of the activity
fix: The manual requires an annual review. The 90 day, 30 day and monthly cadence is local practice. Label it as such.

claim: Hold check covers litigation, active investigation, pending audit and pending member application before disposal.
quote: Regardless of the retention standards established by this manual, records pertaining to
fix: The manual does not list a member pending application as a hold trigger. Keep it as local practice or drop it.

claim: UD/MIPS records are disposed per system disposition procedures.
quote: directs standardization and provides guidance on the use of UD/MIPS for storage of Key Supporting Documents
fix: MARADMIN 601/24 sets storage of key supporting documents. It carries no disposition procedure. Cite the correct authority or soften the line.

claim: Document disposition with a witness and a destruction certificate signed and dated by the witness.
quote: No witness or destruction certificate requirement found in M-5210.1, MCO 5210.11F or DoDI 5200.01.
fix: No archived paragraph requires a witness signature or certificate. Records transferred to an FRC use SF-135. Cite a local SOP or remove the requirement and the Destruction Without Witness error at line 211.

claim: Destruction per M-5210.1 and DoDI 5200.01: cross-cut shredding to NSA standards, cryptographic erasure or physical destruction of media.
quote: Regulation, references (f) and (g), provides for the destruction of classified information
fix: M-5210.1 Part I para 4 defers classified destruction to the DON security regulation. Neither cited document names cross-cut shredding, NSA standards or cryptographic erasure. Cite the NSA/CSS destruction guidance or SECNAV M-5510.36.

claim: Members have Privacy Act rights to know, copy and correct records and PAC must respond within statutory timeframes.
quote: No Privacy Act paragraph found in M-5210.1 or MCO 5210.11F.
fix: Cite SECNAVINST 5211.5 or MCO 5211.5 for Privacy Act rights. M-5210.1 does not carry them.

claim: PAC self-inspections per IG Functional Area Checklist 5210 cover disposition compliance.
quote: Inspectors General Checklist
fix: Cached checklist text holds only the header. Confirm the disposition items against the DOCX.

claim: Disposition authority sits with PAC OIC for routine disposition, HQMC for interpretation, NARA for schedule changes and a Records Officer for oversight.
quote: Oversee respective records programs across the command by establishing a unit file plan and employing lifecycle management in accordance with NARA-approved dispositions
fix: MCO 5210.11F names no PAC OIC disposition authority. The CDRM oversees lifecycle management and HQMC ARDB receives deviation requests under M-5210.1 Part II para 2. Rewrite the list on those roles.

claim: Each PAC designates a Records Officer per M-5210.1.
paragraph: Ch 1 para 3 HQMC Staff Agency Heads and Commanders (a)
quote: Marine Corps commands will appoint CDRMs at the Regiment/Group levels and above. CDRMs will be a company/field grade officer, staff noncommissioned officer
fix: The title is Command Designated Records Manager, appointed in writing by Regiment/Group level commands and above. A PAC does not appoint its own. M-5210.1 designates no unit Records Officer.

claim: Records Officer coordinates self-inspections and keeps the current M-5210.1 reference.
quote: An annual inspection and review of local disposal procedures and of the activity
fix: Annual local review is required. Assign it to the CDRM, not a Records Officer.

claim: Frontmatter lists MARADMIN 331/24 as a reference.
quote: All content currently stored on MCEN unclassified networked shared drives must be transferred to SPO
fix: The message covers shared drive migration to SharePoint Online by 30 September 2025. It has no records disposition content. Remove it or state its relevance.
